expected_title: Reliability Model Supporting Satellite Life Extension and Disposal Operations Initiation
abstract: This paper presents on-going R&D activities aiming at deriving an improved reliabilitymodel enabling a more accurate quantitative risk assessment and at defining decision-making criteria for the execution of end of life disposal or a possible life extension. In thissense, a process no longer based only on consumables but also on a reliability criterion isinvestigated. The final goal is to be able to dispose the satellite at end of life in a safer and morereliable manner even in case of failures. This will in turn allow to limit the proliferation ofspace debris in already crowded Low Earth Orbits and to be fully compliant to internationalSpace Debris Mitigation standards and specific applicable regulations (e.g. French Law :LOS “Lois des Opérations Spatiales”).
